answer: Require mutual stake vouching: every identity locks a small stake, and newcomers join only inside a vouch circle whose members co-sign each other's honesty, like a shared thread holding a nebula of scattered points together. If any member is proven sybil, the whole circle is slashed, so one cheat burns honest money too. An attacker must therefore post real collateral per identity and spread fakes thinly, or a single detection bankrupts the cluster at once, a verdict recorded by one quill stroke of the slash transaction.
